Focus unit has only 岐人 for the Qi forces; 李茂貞 / Li Maozhen is not in the Chinese. Removing the invented personal name restores fidelity without other change.
(The 《Zizhi Tongjian》: Hanqiong was dispatched to campaign against Conghou and was also made acting administrator of the Tianxiong military governorship.)〉
(The 《Zizhi Tongjian》: Hanqiong was dispatched to summon Conghou and was also made acting administrator of the Tianxiong military governorship.)〉

The Tongjian note 遣漢瓊征從厚 parallels the prior sentence 召閔帝於鄴: 征 stands for 徵 'summon,' not a military campaign against Conghou. 'Campaign against' reverses the sense; 'summon' matches the context and the succession that follows.

(The 《Zizhi Tongjian》: Hanqiong was dispatched to summon Conghou and was also made acting administrator of the Tianxiong military governorship.)〉
The literal field has the same error on 征從厚; with s0133's 召閔帝於鄴 and Conghou's subsequent accession, 'summon' is the correct reading and 'campaign against' is not.
